full_name: Annie Rogers | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Annie Rogers, an associate professor in human development and psychology at the Harvard Graduate School of Education, studies gender and psychological development, particularly the effects of trauma on memory and relationships.
